rows.label: Atramentum
rows.note: end-of-mission reward (15 normal/25 Steel Path), 12 balloons a run (shared), enemy drops (not shared)

conditions: Solo needs only 2 Paint per canvas; a full squad needs 6.
No Void Sling or Transference while carrying Paint.
Canvas C is always the lower floor, A the upper concourse, B an upper side room or the hangar; fill B before 50% progress or the guaranteed "Drip, Drip, Drip" modifier walls off routes.
bonuses: Pop every Atramentum Balloon; each gives about 2-3 and Loot Radar shows them on the minimap.
Tanky frames (Hildryn with shield-gating, Wisp, Inaros, Gauss) make the mission close to trivial.

disclosures.title: the currency math
disclosures.body: Enkaus and Follie share the pity currency; her set also costs 2,400, so covering both takes 4,800 Atramentum. Good solo Steel Path runs land 70-80+ Atramentum in 3-5 minutes.

groups.activity: clear the mission for a Rotation A part roll

rows.label: Enkaus Blueprint
rows.note: 5%/6%, shares the table with Follie's four parts and junk

conditions: Zorba prices the main blueprint at three times a component; if a drop comes, you want it to be the main blueprint.
Air Support is disabled, no Focus orbs spawn, and enemies are immune to mercy finishers and Loki's decoy.
